statement: Mucosa-Associated Lymphoid Tissue Lymphoma Translocation 1 Protein (D000074884) — MeSH 2026 scope note: A caspase-like cysteine endopeptidase that also exhibits ubiquitin ligase activity. It contains an N-terminal DEATH DOMAIN, two IMMUNOGLOBULIN-LIKE DOMAINS, and localizes to the perinuclear region of MONOCYTES, where it functions in activation of NF-KAPPA B; it also binds to and activates TRAF6. Chromosomal translocations involving the MALT1 and BIRC2 genes are associated with MALT LYMPHOMA, and mutations in the MALT1 gene are associated with Type 12 IMMUNODEFICIENCY SYNDROMES.

statement: SAM Domain and HD Domain-Containing Protein 1 (D000076106) — MeSH 2026 scope note: A host restriction triphosphorylhydrolase and dNTPase that contains an N-terminal STERILE ALPHA MOTIF and central, conserved ASPARTATE and HISTIDINE (HD) domain. Mutations in the SAMHD1 gene are associated with type 5 Aicardi-Goutieres syndrome (AGS5) and type 2 chilblain LUPUS (CHBL2).

statement: DNA (Cytosine-5-)-Methyltransferase 1 (D000076123) — MeSH 2026 scope note: A DNA (cytosine-5-)-methyltransferase that contains a central CxxC type zinc finger motif. statement: Progranulins (D000077153) — MeSH 2026 scope note: Cysteine-rich, precursor glycoproteins encoded by the granulin gene (GRN). The mammalian GRANULINS are named PARAGRANULIN and granulin 1-7 for their order in the progranulin propeptide.
